title:
Bound in Blood
Multiplayer
text: A separate multiplayer copy of your game with every IranCoJ map and mod. Your original game stays untouched.

title: Third Person
text: Press F5 for an over-the-shoulder view; the middle mouse button swaps shoulders. Scopes switch to first person. Pick your crosshair in Settings.

title: New Classes 2.0.2
text: Silas Greaves, John Wesley Hardin and Billy the Kid as the Rancher, Duelist and Rifleman. 2.0.2 cuts the stutter when they spawn and adds the crosshair styles.

title: Lincoln Town
text: The biggest map in the pack so far. It downloads with your next map update.

title: Spectate Mod 1.0.8
text: The spectate menu button now has its own place in the menu.

title: Showdown on IranCoJ
text: Join the IranCoJ server straight from the launcher, no menus needed.
